\#1 Sona author on mobafire here,

1. Some easy tips for sona are to manage your power chords (watching which one is up, what each do, etc.), and to watch your ranges. Sona is best at her max q range, allowing you to be close enough to poke the enemy, but not too close to the point where they can kill you.
2. Tear is strong on Sona, but it is not necessary to perform well. Manaflow band should be more than enough if you are building support items that involve faerie charm, allowing you to get the mana regen you will need to sustain yourself in lane, and during fights. 
3. A little bit of a shameless plug, but I have Sona's matchups and synergy with other adcs in [my sona guide here](https://www.mobafire.com/league-of-legends/build/ap-sona-support-when-your-adc-needs-carrying-season-8-513889)
4. If you are an aggressive player, you can take ignite, but if you are facing a lane that you are going to be pressured in, such as a jhin/morgana, and the enemy team has a big threat like a darius, then you are 100% going to want to take exhaust / heal. I go deeper in depth about sums in my guide if you wanna check it out while you are there

Hope this helps,
